concern_summary: Manages the display and selection of mention suggestions based on user input, enhancing efficiency in inserting mentions.
Identifies and processes short mentions in comments, ensuring they are correctly formatted and integrated into the final output.
Processes user mentions in text, extracting user account details, formatting them appropriately, and enabling navigation to user profiles related to the mentioned users.
Checks for unread mentions in reports or options by comparing timestamps of last mentions and last reads.
Monitors comment actions to check if the current user is mentioned, updating the relevant report's last mentioned time.
Retrieves and displays details about mention reports, handling navigation interactions based on the mentioned reports.
Identifies actionable mentions, determining if a report action can be acted upon, and constructs messages regarding mentioned users in specific contexts.
